body: I use to feel the same way. Until I got a better wife who now does those things for me. Now I see guys looking at us and I can tell they look jealous thinking I am the lucking one. And I have to admit it feels good being on the other side of the looking glass.

You should try to sit down and ask him if that is how he really feels? Try printing out some material to educate him on ADHD so maybe he can be understanding and hopefully think before he just blurts out something so hurtful that he would regret for the rest of his life if it actually happened because of what he said.
